{{Quote|Before he entered CorSec, Locke served in Special Forces under my command. He's a dependable soldier, and he knows Corellia very well.|General Garza|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Locke''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] and later the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Great Galactic War]], Locke served as a loyal veteran in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] until he retired and returned to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where he joined the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the Sith Empire began to [[Battle of Corellia|invade]] his [[Planet/Legends|planet]], he became one of many Corellians who put his past experience to work in the resistance movement.

In [[3640 BBY]], he welcomed [[Havoc Squad]] that came to aid in reclaiming Corellia from the Empire.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Good-natured and swaggering in the Corellian way, Locke was a passionate defender of his world and people. When the Empire invaded, he welcomed the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] aid reclaiming his homeworld, but had a dim view of the rampant property destruction being inflicted by the non-native troops.
